# Every network call reports errors

`M4` · Coding rule

Every API promise has .catch (or try/catch) calling captureSentryError(error, "", "") and resets every loading/pressed flag (.finally)

Defined in [[brain/context/conventions-mobile|Mobile app coding rules]].
